newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks firmer in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks firmer in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were slightly firmer in early Thursday morning trade after opening on a solid tone, brokers said.
But they said gains would probably be limited as trade volume was not likely to be large and there were no strong incentives to encourage investors to buy.
At 0018 GMT, the key 225-share Nikkei average was up 84.20 points or 0.42 percent at 20,286.07. Its September futures were up 100 points at 20,290.
"The Nikkei average will not stray far from the 20,000 level until factors emerge to push it either way," said Hiroshi Morimoto, general manager at Daiwa Securities.
